descriptions.text: Wand of Nighty-Night. 10 Charges. Knocks an opponent out onto their ass. Casts a level-10 Sleep on a non-boss, single target for a period of five minutes. Opponent will reawaken if they sustain physical damage. Multiple casts compounds the effect, which is why this wand is so fancy. If you don't know what that means, ask a math nerd.

recap.text: Carl opens the wand box in his room, and a gnarled wooden wand clatters onto the table and vanishes before he can examine it. Picked up, it is a Wand of Nighty-Night, ten charges, a level-10 Sleep on one non-boss target for five minutes. When he opens the door, Sister Ines runs at him screaming Sinner, and he zaps her; she drops at his feet. Louis kills her with a dagger.

Carl finds the wand of Nighty-Night in his inventory while Architect Houston begs him not to press the button, talking about the Beautiful Place and the changelings. Telling Burcu sorry, he points the wand at her where she lies bound on a table. Her eyes go wide and she thrashes, and he casts. She conks out under a five-minute timer, and when he hits the switch her magical bindings disappear.

beats.headline: The wand box
beats.text: Opening his loot boxes in his room, Carl gets a patch with a burning book from the Gold Talk of the Town box, and from the wand box a simple, gnarled wooden wand that clatters onto the table and disappears before he can examine it. When he picks it up, it is a Wand of Nighty-Night, ten charges: a level-10 Sleep on a single non-boss target for five minutes, broken by physical damage, compounding with every cast. He pulls it into his inventory.
beats.gist: Carl opens his loot boxes and gets a wooden wand that is a Wand of Nighty-Night.

beats.headline: Sinner
beats.text: Carl pulls his new Nighty-Night wand and opens the door, and a glowing Sister Ines is already running full tilt down the hallway at him, screaming Sinner at the top of her lungs. She is too close. He zaps the wand, and she drops unconscious and slides to a stop at his feet, a two-minute timer over her. Combat starts, but she is out. Louis kills her with a dagger, and a god's marked-for-death symbol appears over his head.
beats.gist: Carl zaps the charging Sister Ines asleep with his Nighty-Night wand, and Louis kills her with a dagger.

beats.headline: Sorry, Burcu
beats.text: Architect Houston begs Carl not to press the button, talking about the Beautiful Place and the changelings. Carl finds what he is looking for in his inventory. Sorry, he tells Burcu, bound on a table, and pulls out the wand of Nighty-Night. Her eyes go wide and she starts to thrash as he points it at her and casts. She conks out under a five-minute timer, he hits the switch, and her magical bindings disappear. Getting onto her table will be tricky: he has to land around her, not on her.
beats.gist: Carl apologizes to Burcu, zaps her with the Nighty-Night wand, and frees her from her bindings.
